column1: # JoyPro's own names and explanations of IL-2 Sturmovik: Cliffs of Dover Blitz actions (written for JoyPro, not copied from the game).
# The name is shown when the game's list has only the id for the action; the explanation is the "what it does" line.

column4: explanation
Raises the altitude set on the bomb sight, so it matches the height you bomb from.
Lowers the altitude set on the bomb sight.
Raises the distance set on the bomb sight.
Lowers the distance set on the bomb sight.
Raises the air speed set on the bomb sight, so it matches your speed on the bomb run.
Lowers the air speed set on the bomb sight.
Moves the bomb sight aim to the left.
Moves the bomb sight aim to the right.
Switches the automatic bomb sight mode on or off.
Overrides the boost limiter for extra engine power in an emergency (Spitfire, Hurricane). Use it only for short bursts.
Pulls the slow-running cut-out, which starves the engine of fuel and stops it.
Switches the propeller pitch control mode (manual or automatic, where the aircraft has both).
Aims the turret gun up.
Aims the turret gun down.
Aims the turret gun left.
Aims the turret gun right.
Moves the gun mount of the gunner position up.
Moves the gun mount of the gunner position down.
Moves the gun mount of the gunner position left.
Moves the gun mount of the gunner position right.
Switches the vehicle between driving forward and reverse.
